newsitem.title: USA: U.S. base metals and scrap prices - June 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. base metals and scrap prices - June 4.

text.p: U.S. premiums added to LME official cash settlement price, except for copper, which is added to the COMEX spot month. Premium includes price for delivery to consumer's works.
Zinc: Special high grade SHG 4.75-5.00 cents/pound
Aluminum alloy (A380 grade), Midwest and East coast, delivered to consumer 74.00-74.50 cents/pound
Aluminum scrap, Midwest and East coast average price,
Old Sheet and Cast metal 52 to 54 cents/pound
Turnings, clean and dry 53 to 54 cents/pound
Copper scrap, Midwest and East coast average price, delivered to consumer
Alcan aluminum, U.S. Midwest (effective date: June 1 1997)
RSR pure lead price (effective date: March 11, 1997)
Doe Run pure lead price (effective date: March 12, 1997)
To see a display of U.S. base metal and scrap prices on a chain, key BASE-US and hit F3 or double-click now on 0#BASE-US. The prices in the BASE-US chain can be pasted into spreadsheet applications.
